name: Ol Doinyo Lengai night climb
why: The only volcano on Earth that erupts black natrocarbonatite lava: a night climb up steep ash to the crater at sunrise, Lake Natron pink below.
book: Climb only with a local guide arranged at Engaresero; Ngorongoro district and village fees. Night start to avoid the heat.
water: No water on the mountain: carry 3-4 litres.
dangers: Very steep loose ash: hard on the knees going down; take poles.
Heat after 09:00 on the bare slope.
Do not go into the crater: the lava can be active.
turnaround: Turn back if you are not at the rim by 07:30.

points.name: Ol Doinyo Lengai trailhead
points.note: The end of the track on the north foot of the volcano, reached by 4x4 from Engaresero.

points.name: Ol Doinyo Lengai
